meta.title: Skill Authoring, Signing & Publish
meta.subtitle: 4-step wizard → draft → sign at publish → bind to agents

cards.title: What a skill is
items: A reusable instruction playbook + reference files shared across agents
Not a Tool (no API calls) and not a KB (not searchable documents)
The description is always loaded so the model can decide to apply it
SKILL.md is injected like a system-prompt fragment

cards.title: Signing & provenance
items: Skills don't execute code → no sandbox / egress / approval, and no credentials
New risk vectors are prompt-injection + provenance, so skills are signed at publish
signature: { signedBy, signedAt, masked } + contentHash on the version
Only published skills are bindable to agents

cards.title: Drift
items: updateSkill (content change) flags every bound agent needsReEval
publishSkill (re-sign) also trips the bound agents' re-eval

cards.title: Mock seams
items: contentHash / signature are synthetic; reference files are metadata-only (no upload)
